name: CommandPalette
label: Command palette
description: A modal Cmd+K launcher that searches a grouped command list, with keyboard navigation and shortcut hints.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the palette requests to open or close

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message shown when the query matches nothing

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a loading affordance in place of results

props.name: loadingMessage
props.description: Status text shown in place of results while `loading` is set. Defaults to "Loading…".

props.name: hotkey
props.description:
Bind Cmd+K / Ctrl+K globally to toggle the palette. Set to false when the
host app owns the shortcut.

props.name: hotkeyKeys
props.description:
The shortcuts that toggle the palette when `hotkey` is on, in the
shortcut grammar. Defaults to `['meta+k', 'ctrl+k']`, so both answer on
every platform. They go through the shared shortcut listener, so they
fire from a text field and over an open dialog.

props.name: keyLabels
props.description: Replaces any legend a command's `keys` is drawn with, such as `{ ctrl: 'Strg' }` for a German keyboard.

props.name: onSelect
props.description:
Called with the chosen command, after its own `onSelect`. Replaces the
native `onSelect` (text-selection) handler on the panel.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called as the user types, for async/server-side search

props.name: manualFiltering
props.description: Skip built-in filtering — use when commands are filtered upstream

props.name: hideFooter
props.description: Hide the hint row at the bottom of the panel

props.name: hintLabels
props.type: { navigate?: string; select?: string; close?: string | undefined; escapeKey?: string | undefined; } | undefined
props.description:
The words in the hint row, merged over the English defaults: the text
beside each key ("to navigate", "to select", "to close") and `escapeKey`,
the visible name on the Escape key cap ("esc").

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the overlay container (the ref and native attributes go on the panel)
